cards.front: What is the method of loci?
cards.back: Placing vivid images of what you want to remember at locations along a familiar route, then recalling them by walking the route in your mind.
Spatial memory is strong and well ordered, so tying abstract facts to places borrows that structure.
Reviews spread out over time produce longer-lasting memory than the same number of reviews crammed together.

cards.front: What does an SRS scheduler decide?
cards.back: When each card is next due, based on how well you recalled it last time.
